data.name: Venturo
data.gender_notes: Venturo is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin ventus, meaning wind, this name has a bold and adventurous feel, conveying the sense of a new beginning and the courage to face challenges with open arms. The name Venturo carries the meaning “Brave, New” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Venturo usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, new and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and resilience of the soul, encouraging one to embark on a journey of self-discovery and growth.
data.etymology: Venturo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, New.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Venturo total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Βεντούρο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βεντούρο προέρχεται από την ιταλική λέξη 'ventura', που σημαίνει 'τύχη' ή 'μέλλον'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Βεντούρο συνδέεται με την έννοια της τύχης και της ευτυχίας. Στην Εκκλησία των Ανατολικών Ρωμαίων, το όνομα Βεντούρο χρησιμοποιείται ως σύμβολο ελπίδας και ευλογίας.
